div.div:
One event per order; immutable quote and lifecycle separate from payment attempts.
ATTRIBUTES (NN required / ? nullable)
id: uuid [PK NN]
default gen_random_uuid()
event_id: uuid [FK NN]
buyer_user_id: uuid [FK NN]
hold_id: uuid [FK UQ NN]
status: text [NN]
default 'pending'
currency: text [NN]
default 'KZT'
gross_minor: bigint [NN]
discount_minor: bigint [NN]
default 0
payable_minor: bigint [NN]
processing_fee_minor: bigint [NN]
default 0
processing_rate_bps: integer [NN]
default 300
policy_snapshot: jsonb [NN]
event_snapshot: jsonb [NN]
quote_expires_at: timestamptz [NN]
confirmed_at: timestamptz [?]
fulfillment_payment_attempt_id: uuid [FK UQ ?]
created_at: timestamptz [NN]
default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
CONSTRAINTS
UQ1: (hold_id)
UQ2: (fulfillment_payment_attempt_id)
UQ3: (id, event_id)
UQ4: (id, event_id, hold_id)
CK1: status IN
('pending','confirmed','failed','expired','cancelled','refund_pending','refunded')
CK2: currency = 'KZT'
CK3: gross_minor >= 0 AND discount_minor BETWEEN 0 AND gross_minor
CK4: payable_minor = gross_minor - discount_minor
CK5: processing_fee_minor BETWEEN 0 AND payable_minor
CK6: processing_rate_bps BETWEEN 0 AND 10000
CK7: jsonb_typeof(policy_snapshot) = 'object' AND jsonb_typeof(event_snapshot) = 'object'
CK8: status NOT IN ('confirmed','refund_pending','refunded') OR confirmed_at IS NOT NULL
CK9: confirmed_at IS NULL OR ((payable_minor = 0 AND fulfillment_payment_attempt_id IS
NULL) OR (payable_minor > 0 AND fulfillment_payment_attempt_id IS NOT NULL))
FOREIGN KEYS / UML ASSOCIATIONS
(hold_id, event_id, buyer_user_id) -> checkout_hold(id, event_id, buyer_user_id) [1
parent / 0..1 children]
(fulfillment_payment_attempt_id, event_id) -> payment_attempt(id, event_id) [0..1 parent
/ 0..1 children]
All FK deletes/updates: RESTRICT. See TX rules for cross-row guards.

div.div:
One admission unit, not an aggregate line: simplifies seat, recipient, ticket and refund
mapping.
ATTRIBUTES (NN required / ? nullable)
id: uuid [PK NN]
default gen_random_uuid()
order_id: uuid [FK NN]
event_id: uuid [FK NN]
hold_id: uuid [FK NN]
ticket_type_id: uuid [FK NN]
allocation_id: uuid [FK UQ NN]
unit_number: integer [NN]
ticket_type_name: text [NN]
recipient_name: text [NN]
recipient_email: text [NN]
face_value_minor: bigint [NN]
discount_minor: bigint [NN]
default 0
paid_minor: bigint [NN]
processing_fee_minor: bigint [NN]
default 0
seat_snapshot: jsonb [?]
created_at: timestamptz [NN]
default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
CONSTRAINTS
UQ1: (allocation_id)
UQ2: (order_id, unit_number)
UQ3: (id, event_id)
CK1: unit_number > 0
CK2: recipient_email = lower(btrim(recipient_email))
CK3: face_value_minor >= 0 AND discount_minor BETWEEN 0 AND face_value_minor
CK4: paid_minor = face_value_minor - discount_minor
CK5: processing_fee_minor BETWEEN 0 AND paid_minor
CK6: seat_snapshot IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(seat_snapshot) = 'object'
FOREIGN KEYS / UML ASSOCIATIONS
(order_id, event_id, hold_id) -> ticket_order(id, event_id, hold_id) [1 parent / 0..*
children]
(allocation_id, event_id, hold_id, ticket_type_id) -> inventory_allocation(id, event_id,
hold_id, ticket_type_id) [1 parent / 0..1 children]
All FK deletes/updates: RESTRICT. See TX rules for cross-row guards.
